text:
raj: CI eval-runner flagged a quality regression on mage-x-1.2-q4f during the nightly suite — looks like a tokenizer/chat template mismatch. anyone seen this?
emma: I reproduced locally, failing test is `chat_template_roundtrip`. token counts differ between our harness and the onboard tokenizer. :eyes:
emma: log snippet:
```
INPUT: \"User: Hi
Assistant: Hello\"
TOKENIZER: legacy-tokenizer-v0
tokenized_len: 128
expected_len: 126
```
kai: That +2 token shift will shift KV cache alignment and explain the rouge/bleu drops we saw. similar to past nova runs but with a different sentinel handling.
raj: This CI run used quant profile `q4f-lite` from PR #1478 (sha abc1234). job id 48291 shows `metrics` reported ~5m after run end, which hid the regression until the dashboard aggregated.
dev-bot: Build failed — eval-runner/48291 — exit 1 — https://ci/internal/48291 :warning:
priya: Two quick asks: (1) can the harness toggle `preserve-sentinels` or a compat mode for legacy tokenizer? (2) can we re-run this case against a float model variant as a sanity check? :thumbsup:
emma: I tried `tokenizer_compat: \"legacy_preserve\"` in a local harness config and token counts line up — tests pass.
raj: Proposal: patch model config mapping in eval-harness to prefer `legacy_preserve` for mage-x-1.2 and add a regression test asserting token_len equality for chat templates. PR diff sketch:
```
diff --git a/models/mage-x/config.yaml b/models/mage-x/config.yaml
tokenizer:
  name: legacy-tokenizer-v0
  compat_mode: legacy_preserve
```
I'll open the PR and queue a re-run.
kai: Also add a small unit test in runner: assert tokenized_len(expected_prompt) == tokenized_len(actual_prompt) for each chat template in the repo. That will catch future template/tokenizer drift.
priya: We should also add a CI liveness signal: emit `metrics-ready` webhook at end-of-run so dashboards don't hide delayed metrics as drops.
emma: I'll draft two PRs: harness config + test, and a dashboard mapping change to mark delayed metrics as `pending` rather than `missing`.
raj: thanks — tagging @eng-oncall in case infra is causing the 5m delay.
dev-bot: Rerun requested by raj — eval-runner/48292 queued.
raj: assign me to the PRs, will follow up with results of rerun. :thumbsup:
